-- EXECUTION COUNTER & TIME LOGIC
------------------------------------------------------------------

    end

        writefile(ppath, tostring(executionCount))
    end)

    end)

        end)

            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Error]: Failed to fetch URL content!"
            return
        end
    end

    if func then
        local success, err = pcall(func)
        if success then
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Success]: Script executed successfully without errors."

        ConsoleBox.Text = "[Syntax Error]: " .. tostring(syntaxErr)
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.sub(string.lower(p.Name), 1, string.len(text)) == string.lower(text) then

    local target = getTargetPlayerName()

            if extraArg then
                fullCmd = string.format(cmdFormat, target, extraArg)
            else
                fullCmd = string.format(cmdFormat, target)

    end
